acceptance: Exact release identity is preserved
Human production authorization remains separate from technical verification
Mirror cannot deploy canonical production
Protected/default/open-PR branches are never deleted
Unknown or unique history is retained
Destructive apply is revalidated against live Git state
Repository evidence retains provenance
Learning does not self-promote to Certified Memory
Optimization candidates require review before canonical adoption
No credentials are committed
Provider endpoints remain explicitly configured
Hosted or local inference never becomes DataNest identity authority
Migration lineage is preserved
RLS/authorization impact is reviewed
Rollback or recovery implications are documented
Canonical and Mirror authority remain distinct
Unclassified paths fail closed
FREETREE remains outside all synchronization paths
Relevant tests remain reproducible
Advisory evidence is not mislabeled as certification

hardRules.message: FREETREE must remain isolated from canonical and Mirror synchronization.
Scheduled maintenance may delete only branches proven to have no unique commits; archived unique history requires separate explicit authorization.
Vercel is not a required DataNest delivery dependency.

resultSemantics.pass: No hard boundary violation detected; required human/evidence acceptance still applies.
resultSemantics.review: A change touches a governed scope and requires the listed acceptance evidence.
resultSemantics.block: A machine-verifiable DataNest invariant was violated.
